== Defensive Shields ==

These cards were posted as Defensive Shields outside the 60. They do not count toward the 60.

* 1x {{CardLink|A Useless Gesture|Ref3-D-auselessgesture.gif}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Allegations Of Corruption (Dark)|Ref3-D-allegationsofcorruption.gif|label=Allegations Of Corruption}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Come Here You Big Coward (Dark)|Ref3-D-comehereyoubigcoward.gif|label=Come Here You Big Coward}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Do They Have A Code Clearance? (Dark)|Ref3-D-dotheyhaveacodeclearance.gif|label=Do They Have A Code Clearance?}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Fanfare (Dark)|Ref3-D-fanfare.gif|label=Fanfare}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Leave Them To Me (Dark)|Ref3-D-leavethemtome.gif|label=Leave Them To Me}}
* 1x {{CardLink|There Is No Try (Dark)|Ref3-D-thereisnotry.gif|label=There Is No Try}}
* 1x {{CardLink|We'll Let Fate-a Decide, Huh?|Ref3-D-wellletfateadecidehuh.gif}}
* 1x {{CardLink|Weapon Of A Sith|Ref3-D-weaponofasith.gif}}
* 1x {{CardLink|You've Never Won A Race?|Ref3-D-youveneverwonarace.gif}}

Posted in the starting section as '10 Shields' (not counted in Starting (8)): A Useless Gesture, Allegations of Corruption, Come Here You Big Coward, Do They Have A Code Clearance?, Fanfare, Leave Them To Me, There Is No Try, We'll Let Fate-a Decide, Huh?, Weapon of a Sith, You've Never Won A Race?

The post also lists 1x SSa, which matches no known card; it is shown as posted and counted in the published total.
